## Scope

Describe the problem and the intentionally limited solution.

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Tests pass and regression coverage was added where appropriate
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Retrieval benchmark passes or an intentional baseline change is explained
- [ ] Packed artifact verification passes

## Impact

- [ ] Windows/Linux/macOS impact considered
- [ ] DSH compatibility impact documented
- [ ] Storage or migration impact documented
- [ ] Security and untrusted-input impact reviewed
- [ ] Chinese and English user documentation updated when needed
- [ ] CHANGELOG or release notes updated for user-visible behavior

## Notes

Include logs, benchmark diffs, screenshots, or migration details that help the
reviewer verify the change. Never include credentials or private documents.
